name: Mohist
author: pelican-eggs
description: Mohist est un serveur Minecraft Forge hybride qui implémente les API Bukkit, Spigot et Paper. Permet d'utiliser des mods Forge ET des plugins Bukkit/Spigot ensemble.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Mohist Installation Script
# Server Files: /mnt/server

PROJECT="mohist"
API_BASE="https://api.mohistmc.com/project"

echo "========================================"
echo "  Mohist Server Installation"
echo "========================================"

# Use custom download URL if provided
if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
    echo "Using custom download URL: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')
else
    echo "Minecraft Version: ${MC_VERSION}"
    
    # Get build number if not specified
    if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
        echo "Fetching latest build for ${MC_VERSION}..."
        BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -s "${API_BASE}/${PROJECT}/${MC_VERSION}/builds" | jq -r '.[0].id')
        
        if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "null" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Could not fetch build info for version ${MC_VERSION}"
            echo "Please check available versions at https://mohistmc.com/downloads"
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    
    echo "Build Number: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="${API_BASE}/${PROJECT}/${MC_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/download"
fi

cd /mnt/server

# Backup existing jar if present
if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    echo "Backing up existing ${SERVER_JARFILE}..."
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.backup"
fi

# Download server jar
echo ""
echo "Downloading Mohist server..."
echo "URL: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
echo ""

curl -L -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

# Verify download
if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "${SERVER_JARFILE}" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "${SIZE}" -gt 1000000 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "Download successful!"
        echo "File size: ${SIZE} bytes"
        
        # Remove backup if download succeeded
        rm -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.backup"
        
        # Create eula.txt
        echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
        echo "EULA accepted."
        
        echo ""
        echo "========================================"
        echo "  Installation Complete!"
        echo "========================================"
        echo ""
        echo "IMPORTANT - Java Version Guide:"
        echo "  MC 1.7.10 - 1.16.5 : Java 8"
        echo "  MC 1.17.x          : Java 16"
        echo "  MC 1.18 - 1.20.4   : Java 17"
        echo "  MC 1.20.5+         : Java 21"
        echo ""
    else
        echo "ERROR: Downloaded file is too small (${SIZE} bytes)"
        echo "Download may have failed."
        
        # Restore backup
        if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.backup" ]; then
            mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}.backup" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
        fi
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "ERROR: Download failed - file not found"
    exit 1
fi

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Nom du fichier JAR du serveur.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Numéro de build spécifique (optionnel). Laissez vide pour la dernière version stable.

variables.description: URL personnalisée pour télécharger le JAR (optionnel, pour usage avancé).
